title: UTMB World Series Majors — prize money and Finals places
claims: UTMB World Series Majors pay equal men's and women's prize money at 50K, 100K and 100M: €5,000 for first, €3,000 for second, €2,000 for third, €1,250 for fourth and €1,000 for fifth.
Each Major grants automatic UTMB World Series Finals places to the top 10 men and women in the 100M, 100K and 50K plus age-group winners; the four Majors allocate 210 places in total.
Kodiak is listed as the Americas Major alongside the European, Asia-Pacific and Oceania Majors.
